description: This file is a C header file defining macros, inline functions, and including external libraries related to safe string and memory operations, primarily for secure coding practices in C. It also contains licensing information and conditional compilation for a dummy API implementation.

methods.name: parseFormat
methods.description: A static inline function that formats a string with variable arguments, used internally for safe string operations.

methods.name: strcmp_s
methods.description: A static inline function that compares two strings safely and returns a status code and result.

methods.name: strcasecmp_s
methods.description: A static inline function that compares two strings case-insensitively, safely.

methods.name: memcmp_s
methods.description: A static inline function that compares two memory blocks safely, returning a status code and comparison result.
